verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents an Organizations feature for managing customer organizations within a realm, realms as isolated tenants, and identity brokering to external OIDC or SAML 2.0 IdPs configured through the admin console. A community user also reports integrating many external IdPs for SSO. However, the evidence never shows an IdP being bound to a specific organization, domain verification, or users being auto-created on first brokered login. missing for 10: per-organization IdP linkage, verified/claimed domain support, explicit just-in-time provisioning documentation, independent corroboration of org-scoped SSO.
